transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I’m worried about how I’ve been eating at night. Once I start picking at food, I tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but then my hand just keeps going back. It feels like I don’t really get to make the decision anymore.
When you’re eating at night, do you feel like you can’t stop eating or control how much you eat once you start?

Yes. That’s the part that worries me. Once I start picking at food late at night, I’ll tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but then I keep reaching for more anyway. It feels like I’m not really the one deciding anymore.
Do you find yourself eating this way even when you’re not physically hungry?
Yes. A lot of the time I’ve already eaten dinner with everyone, so I’m not really hungry. But later on I still find myself opening the fridge and starting up again.
